item.title: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition review - ChristCenteredGamer
item.description: CCG writes - "Metroid Prime 4: Beyond is both flawed and excellent. Technically, artistically, and sonically, it's nearly flawless. The main gameplay represents Metroid Prime quite well, and it plays like a dream. Unfortunately, the level design and some gameplay decisions are a mixed bag. Even despite this, I can't consider Prime 4 any less than a very good game, even if it falls short of greatness. item.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon Brings it All Together - Cinelinx
item.description: Becky O'Brien: "While Ive yet to encounter a Trails game I didnt like, Trails Beyond the Horizon is easily the best entry in the overall series to date. The story has grown bigger than ever, while still feeling like a peaceful escape from the madness of reality. If you havent jumped into the Trails series before, please give this game a chance, you wont be sorry."
